prediction_policy: Canonical rawT1 E,C,N probabilities from original FP32 logits: E>0.5 ->true; elseN>0.5 ->neutral; elsefalse. Argmaxdiagnostic same48readouts neverprimaryselected. No fitting/calibration/temperature change.

context.source_fields: Original claim as hypothesis, only supplied official evidence[*].sentence as premise material. Forbidden labels/rationale/justification/sci_digest/images/captions/sourcepage fetches never inputs.
context.native: One actual native RuVector query per case over all source-provided evidence units; return/validate allN hits and reorder by native rank. This is evidence ordering before token budget, not a claim of absent evidence.
context.lexical: Same supplied unit set ranked by fixed lower-case word-overlap query score with original source-index tie break.
context.source_order: Same complete supplied sentence list in original order before tokenizer budget.
context.truncation: ONLY_FIRST premise truncation preserves the full original hypothesis; STOP if fullhypothesis cannotfit. Explicit deviation from author longest-first truncation, and source_order is budgeted not untruncated full context.
context.numeric_checks: Audit literal quantity/date coverage and truncation without label overrides or formal numeric certificates. Missing retrieval never proves neutral/insufficient evidence.
context.caps_policy: Post-fixed12-selection STOP without replacement; neverdropunits or pick anothercase.

leak_guard.application: Check all supplied evidence and each actual packed premise beforeNNI. AnyhitSTOP captured/no replacement, no rating-stripping/sentence deletion. Preserve all12 selected IDs.
leak_guard.limits: Conservative fixed surface guard, not proof no semantic leakage exists.
leak_guard.matching_normalization: UnicodeNFKC,casefold,whitespacecollapse ONLY for matching; all actual model/source text preserved.
leak_guard.self_claim: STOP if packedpremise equals fullclaim after normalization or every nonempty supplied unit equals claim.

metrics.primary_accuracy: All12 cases with official strict ordered threshold decisions.
metrics.official_macro: Defaultlabels=None observed gold/prediction union, as pinned sklearn source calls in author anli.py. Fixed3class only optional separate diagnostic.
metrics.NLL_clipping: Only clearly separated1e-12 diagnostic, never gate.
metrics.latency: Retain per-readout model/context/forward observations plus whole600s batch; report actualp50/p95 with component/whole scope.
metrics.resources: Actual CPUaffinity/threads/user-system/RSS/high-water observations, not summed simultaneous memory.
